Main central doorway, upper pavilion storey with window panels, smaller upper neck, then tall tapered FLOWER-TOWER crown covered in selectively outlined miniature niches and elephant/lion relief shapes, topped by a small octagonal roof and finial. Exactly this unique central + four subsidiary massing, not a conventional many-eave pagoda. Maintain the photograph's real proportions and visible structural levels. Render frontal symmetry with central main doorway centered, complete tower 82% image height on portrait 1024×1536. Remove incense burner, people, shrubs, paving pattern, signs, background buildings.
